info.title: Yandex Home REST API
info.description: Headless REST adapter for Yandex Home devices, scenarios, and account data. The default listener is http://127.0.0.1:8765 (Debug fixtures use 8766). Host and port can be configured. Clients send no REST key or OAuth Authorization header: Yandex OAuth is configured on the server through a saved login or an oauth_token JSON profile. Browser Origin requests are rejected and CORS is disabled. Request bodies are limited to 65536 bytes. The default response deadline is 30000 ms and can be changed with the worker --timeout option. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

servers.description: Default listener or manually selected host and port

host.description: Listener address; include brackets around IPv6 literals.

port.description: Use the port from the CLI status URL; fixture default is 8766.

get.description: This is HTTP listener/protocol status. CLI control status additionally reports host, port, URL, PID, enabled preference, and fixture state.

get.summary: Read device state and capability metadata

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: Exact entity ID. URL-encode reserved characters, including slashes, as one path segment.

post.description: Capabilities, instances, ranges, modes, and color models are checked against fresh device metadata. Success means Yandex accepted the action; there is no polling, physical-state confirmation, or automatic retry. Canceling response delivery cannot undo an already submitted action.

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: Exact entity ID. URL-encode reserved characters, including slashes, as one path segment.

get.summary: List scenarios and their active state

post.description: The scenario must exist and be active. Content-Type: application/json is required even when no body is sent. The body is ignored; an empty body or {} is recommended. Success acknowledges upstream execution and does not confirm physical device state.

requestBody.description: Optional ignored JSON body; application/json is still required without a body.

parameters.name: scenario_id
parameters.description: Exact entity ID. URL-encode reserved characters, including slashes, as one path segment.

get.summary: Get account identity and default email

code.description: Stable error code; see each response description.

message.description: Human-readable message in the server UI language.

type.description: Full Yandex capability type, such as devices.capabilities.on_off.

parameters.description: Yandex metadata: supported instances, ranges, modes, and color models.

state.description: Current capability state; may be empty.

last_updated.description: Upstream timestamp in seconds; may be zero when absent upstream.

type.description: Full Yandex property type, such as devices.properties.float.

state.description: Current property state; may be empty.

last_updated.description: Upstream timestamp in seconds; may be zero when absent upstream.

email.description: Default account email; an empty string is possible.

instance.description: A toggle instance supported by this device, such as mute.
A range instance supported by this device, such as brightness or volume.

value.description: Finite absolute value or delta. Device-specific bounds apply to absolute values.

relative.description: Apply a relative delta instead of an absolute value.

value.description: One of the values advertised in the device capability parameters.
Packed RGB integer (0xRRGGBB); hexadecimal strings are not accepted by REST.
Color temperature in Kelvin, within device-advertised bounds.
Scene ID advertised by the device.

DeviceAction.description: Send exactly one capability action. Short and full capability names are accepted. Only range accepts the relative field, including relative=false.

relative.description: Apply a relative delta instead of an absolute value.

OpenApiDocument.description: The raw OpenAPI document. It has no ok success envelope. The first server URL identifies the listener that served it.

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON, action shape, typed value, or device-specific bounds. Codes: invalid_json, invalid_action, invalid_value.

Unauthorized.description: The upstream Yandex API rejected or lacks the server OAuth session. Code: authorization_required. This is not a client REST authentication challenge.

Forbidden.description: Host or browser Origin is not permitted, or the upstream Yandex API denied access. Codes: host_forbidden, origin_forbidden, authorization_required.

NotFound.description: Route, device, scenario, or matching capability was not found. Codes: not_found, scenario_not_found, capability_not_found.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path exists but does not accept this HTTP method. Code: method_not_allowed.

Conflict.description: A scenario is inactive or multiple capabilities match. Codes: inactive_scenario, ambiguous_capability.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds 65536 bytes. Code: body_too_large.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Every POST requires Content-Type: application/json, including an empty scenario request. Code: content_type.

SpecUnavailable.description: The bundled OpenAPI document is unavailable. Code: spec_unavailable.

BadGateway.description: An upstream transport, service, or malformed-response failure. Code: api_error.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The REST listener is stopping. Code: disabled.

GatewayTimeout.description: The upstream operation or response deadline expired. Code: timeout.
